contract.assumptions: This is an obstruction to one universal balanced three-source entropy lift. It is not a W3 counterexample, does not contradict the older arbitrary-classical-channel/qubit-reference global mutual-information theorem, and does not establish a t log t fixed-prior matrix-SDPI separation.
contract.costs: Exact 2x2 spectral evaluation and a continuity argument for faithful perturbations; no channel construction, physical measurement, or computational advantage is asserted.
contract.obstruction: A multi-source result needs additional hypotheses or a different mechanism. The general coherent WH3 target and a compatible fixed-prior SDPI separation remain open.
contract.provides: The scalar balanced third finite difference s(a+b+c)-s(a+b)-s(a+c)-s(b+c)+s(a)+s(b)+s(c), for s(t)=-t log t, is nonnegative for all a,b,c>=0. For the three real qubit trine projectors P_0,P_1,P_2, the corresponding balanced matrix trace-entropy expression is (3/2)log(3/4)<0, since the sum has spectrum (3/2,3/2), each pair has spectrum (3/2,1/2), and each individual projector has spectrum (1,0). The scalar-to-matrix transfer therefore fails in this explicit three-source case, and negativity persists under sufficiently small positive epsilon-identity perturbations.
contract.requires: Three positive semidefinite operators on C^2; entropy S(Y)=-Tr Y log Y with natural logarithms; compare the same balanced coefficients as the scalar third finite difference.

source_excerpts.text:
For scalar entropy s(t)=-t log t, every a,b,c>=0 satisfies
s(a+b+c)-s(a+b)-s(a+c)-s(b+c)+s(a)+s(b)+s(c)>=0.
For positive arguments this is the third finite difference of s, equal to
integral_0^a integral_0^b integral_0^c [1/(u+v+w)^2] du dv dw>=0.
The integrable corner singularity and boundary cases follow by positive
regularization or continuity. The combination is balanced in each of a,b,c.

source_excerpts.text:
Take three real qubit trine projectors Pi=|psi_i><psi_i|, with
psi0=(1,0), psi1=(-1/2,sqrt3/2), psi2=(-1/2,-sqrt3/2).
They are positive, have unit trace, and sum to(3/2)I2. Every pair has spectrum
(3/2,1/2), while each individual projector has spectrum(1,0). Consequently the
same balanced matrix trace-entropy expression is
(3/2)log(3/4)<0.
Thus a universally valid balanced THREE-source scalar entropy inequality can
fail on2x2 matrices. This is a precise obstruction, not just lack of a proof.
